   op/push.t / op/splice.t / op/unshift.t DIFF -> OK

PROVED NOT #291 (do not re-derive): transpiled all 21 TRANSPILE files at
66bdb93 (main immediately before #291) and compared the first error line,

THE WORK (do NOT just run --bless-rows / regenerate):
 1. Per-file audit of the 44 C_ok decreases, the way #223 audited the sweep

    (b) an unexamined loss — file it.  The 21 TRANSPILE files are the bulk and
    should collapse to a handful of `Parser2 TODO:` families (seen so far:

    our $x++", "non-scalar state declaration outside a named-sub statement",

 2. Only then re-bless the snapshot, with a `# taken-at:` stamp, from a run
    whose verdict is understood.  Blessing first would make 44 decreases the
    new normal and hide the next real one.
 3. Consider whether the companion suite needs the sweep's LOST bucket
